book_meta.work: The Seven Voyages of Sindbad, from ألف ليلة وليلة
book_meta.author: traditional

sentences.en: One day, we passed some grapevines.

sentences.ar: عصرت العنب بقرعة كبيرة وتركتها بالشمس.
sentences.en: I pressed the grapes in a big gourd and left it in the sun.

sentences.ar: بعد أيام، شربت منها وارتحت شوي.
sentences.en: After days, I drank from it and felt a little better.

sentences.ar: الرجل شاف وجهي وبده يشرب كمان.
sentences.en: The man saw my face and wanted to drink too.
He drank a lot and his legs loosened.
He fell off my back and I fled.
I was the first man to escape him.
